turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why did my son find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
I don't think this is productive.
"Productive." My son got a zero on his phone in front of his class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and before or after anyone spoke to him?
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
You asked for this meeting, Hale. You can leave when you've told me who entered that zero and why nobody called me first, or I go upstairs to the principal.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

"Email the principal if you want." I'm not emailing anyone, I'm walking up there with procedure 4.2 in my bag, and I'll tell her you were done after two minutes. Or you can answer me now: was Owen heard before that zero went in?
